package middleware

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type actorContextKey struct{}

type Actor struct {
	UserID string
	Role   string
}

func RequireStudent(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		userID := strings.TrimSpace(request.Header.Get("X-User-ID"))
		role := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(request.Header.Get("X-User-Role")))
		if _, err := uuid.Parse(userID); err != nil || (role != "STUDENT" && role != "STUDENT_PRO") {
			http.Error(writer, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
			return
		}
		actor := Actor{UserID: userID, Role: role}
		next.ServeHTTP(writer, request.WithContext(context.WithValue(request.Context(), actorContextKey{}, actor)))
	})
}

func ActorFromContext(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
	actor, ok := ctx.Value(actorContextKey{}).(Actor)
	return actor, ok
}
